description:
Leave a request at a Kaio business for a service marked on_request (get_kaio_business): no slot is
    picked, the owner calls back to fix day and time. `description`: what is needed (job, address or area,
    sizes…); `preferred_time`: free text ("mattina", "dopo le 17", "settimana prossima"). A phone or an email
    is required. First recap business, service, description, preferred time and contact details to the
    person, and call this only after they say yes.
name: request_kaio_appointment
title: Request appointment
